newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 9-mth oil consumption up at 361,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 9-mth oil consumption up at 361,000 bpd.

text.p: The Department of Energy said on Thursday the Philippines' petroleum product consumption for the first nine months of the year rose by 4.9 percent to 98.897 million barrels from 94.306 million barrels for the same period last year.
This translates to an increase in the average per calendar day petroleum consumption of 361,000 barrels from last year's 345,000 barrels.
"The growth was primarily driven by the robust petroleum demand of the transport and the household sectors," the department said in a report.
Petroleum consumption of various industries, however, slid by 0.16 percent to 54.93 million barrels from last year's 55.02 barrels. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
